enchantments.tooltip: Quality Seeker +1: Provides a +1 Quality bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +1 Quality bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).

Improved Deception: This item makes your weapons hard to focus upon and thus provides a +14 enhancement bonus to Bluff checks. In addition, while using this item your weapons have a chance to envelop the target in darkness, making them vulnerable to sneak attacks for a short time.
Legendary Accuracy +2: Passive: +2 Legendary bonus to attack rolls
Legendary Deadly +1: +1 Legendary bonus to weapon damage.
